dec.pe: Belgian police asked Roma families to come in to “complete their files”, then arrested and deported them together. The Court found an unlawful collective expulsion.
dec.pi: Polisi Belgia meminta keluarga Roma datang untuk “melengkapi berkas”, lalu menangkap dan mendeportasi mereka bersama-sama. Mahkamah menyatakan itu pengusiran kolektif yang tidak sah.

dec.pe: A Georgian man with leukaemia faced deportation from Belgium. The Grand Chamber said Belgium had to check whether he could get treatment before sending him away.
dec.pi: Seorang pria Georgia penderita leukemia akan dideportasi dari Belgia. Majelis Agung menyatakan Belgia wajib memeriksa apakah ia bisa mendapat perawatan sebelum memulangkannya.
